propositions: code-review-verify spec emits {verifications: [...]} with no decision polarity (verdict/findings), causing _verdict_decision to default all cases to advisory regardless of gold label
V-real-defect (gold block) is guaranteed recall miss because verifier output maps to advisory, not block
mapping non-empty verifications list to block would fix recall miss but simultaneously mis-score V-clean-rename (gold advisory) as block, creating false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from parity corpus by a separate, named mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS exclusion to preserve the reason (no polarity) for future readers
exclusion reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20) and raises recall on both standard and frontier arms symmetrically without changing gating verdicts
